identity.product_outcome: A read-only cross-ledger integrity auditor that detects orphaned or contradictory governance/public evidence without mutating canonical sources.
identity.artist_job: Keep retained requirements, implementations, public handoffs, acceptance evidence and waiting work traceable instead of silently dropping them.

bounded_increment.description: Add the disjoint read-only cross-ledger integrity contract, auditor and adversarial tests.

semantic_contract.required_behavior: Audit materialized canonical N0TE and public projections for broken traceability, equivalence, live-state, resurrection and authority relationships while remaining read-only and non-authoritative.
non_negotiable_semantics: historical gaps warn rather than fabricate identifiers
merge evidence does not prove public or human acceptance
incomplete equivalence cannot silently close retained semantics
waiting work requires a durable wake or successor condition
auditor findings do not grant merge, public, provider or human authority
allowed_implementation_freedom: ordering of findings when semantic content is preserved
interpretations_required: Steward decides whether a finding blocks integration once the auditor is wired into trusted intake
remaining_semantics: production materialization of fresh canonical N0TE and public projections
trusted-base integration into Steward intake after the incident-repair chain

behavior.requested_behavior: Detect orphaned requirements, implementations, public handoffs, receipts, acceptance, equivalence and waiting-state defects across read-only projections.
behavior.implemented_behavior: Adds contract-driven validation for orphan requirements/implementations/public handoffs/public receipts/acceptance, dangling bridges, unproven equivalence, stale live claims, missing resurrection conditions and authority mismatches, with ERROR/WARN/INFO output and source immutability checks.
